fixes.system: src/render/materials.js uBandBleed / uWetPx wet-edge term (:678, :1382) and the bandBleed defaults (:1256, :1326, :1568, :1822)

fixes.change: Raise uWetPx so the warp term spans 5-9 screen px instead of the current ~2, and make the bleed amplitude proportional to the step it is crossing: wetBands = (warp-0.5)*2.0*clamp(dPerPx*uWetPx, 0.0, 1.6)*uBandBleed*(0.5 + 1.5*abs(bandStep)). Set the bandBleed defaults from 1.0/1.25/1.1 to 1.9/2.2/2.0 and drive the warp from a 2-octave fbm at 0.006 world units so the boundary CONTOUR wobbles by +/-4 px as well as softening.
